name: Sakura Bitmap
source:
In the quiet town of Koisaki-chou, it is very rare for a boy to be born. Fumitaka is the lone boy among girls and it was quite problematic. Many years have passed and it is still the same. There’s a local festival Koisaki-matsuri that lots of girls attend since it is said that one can find love there. He has a feeling that he too will fall in love.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在寧靜的戀崎町，男嬰出生可說是稀罕事。文孝從小身邊都是女孩，只有他一個男生，為此遇到了不少麻煩。多年過去，情況依然沒有改變。當地有個名叫「戀崎祭」的祭典，許多女孩都會參加，因為據說人們能在那裡找到愛情。文孝隱約覺得，自己也會墜入愛河。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
